title: docs(components): write the counting rule into the two SVG-host pass-through docblocks
body:
Fixes #9764

`Clause-②: no` — two source comments; no declaration face moves.

## What this card turned out to be

The card was filed reading the two docblocks as ROTTED. Triage measured it and graded it
the other way, and I re-took all three of its readings before relying on any of them:
**both sentences are TRUE today**, so there is no dating apparatus here, no falsifier, no
"true when written" preamble, and none of objectui#9753's BORN-FALSE correction. What was
missing was the **counting rule**, and that is what lands: one sentence in each docblock.

What "declares exactly" counts is the keys an author can WRITE and the renderer can
RECEIVE. A `never`-typed refuse-by-name is the tombstone of an adjudicated-retired key and
is not counted. Each added sentence points at that key's own `@deprecated` line and at the
ruling's provenance instead of restating either, and names the RULE rather than copying
today's member list — a sentence that copies a member list is the defect this family of
cards exists to treat.

## The three readings, re-taken (ref `d18322415`, my own worktree)

1. **The `never` keys' own verdict.** `awk` over each interface body at `d18322415`:
   `IconSchema` (`packages/types/src/layout.ts`) = `type` · `icon` · `size` · `color` ·
   `body` · `children`, the last two `never`; `SpinnerSchema`
   (`packages/types/src/feedback.ts`) = `type` · `size` · `body` · `children`, same. Both
   `never` pairs carry `REFUSED BY NAME (objectui#9256, ADR-0049)` and
   `@deprecated Not a channel … reads — nothing renders it`.
2. **The ruling.** `tombstoned on both published faces (maintainer ruling, summon #17
   decision batch #2, 2026-09-07)` — 7 occurrences in `packages/types/src/layout.ts`, and
   quoted verbatim in the objectui#9256 family-D pin
   (`packages/types/src/__tests__/content-channel-family-d-9256.test.ts`), which covers
   both of these schemas.
3. **The sentences' own arithmetic — extended past triage's reading.** Triage made this
   argument for `spinner` only ("beyond the SDUI base"). It holds for `icon` too, and that
   is a measurement rather than an analogy: at the authoring ref `e304a4ef7`,
   `IconSchema` already declared `type: 'icon'` alongside `icon` / `size` / `color`, and
   the sentence still said "exactly `icon`, `size` and `color`". Its unit was therefore
   never "interface member declaration", before any `never` key existed.

## The exit channel: not triggered, and the nearest miss, reported not adjudicated

I swept governed text in both repos — `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/`, `skills/`,
`docs/adr/` here, and the same plus ADR-0049 in `objectstack` — for a line that counts a
`never` key as a declared member. **None exists.** The nearest thing, reported because it
is a judgement call and not mine to settle:

- `skills/objectui/guides/plugin-development.md` (governed, published skills tree) labels
  ADR-0049 retirement tombstones `DECLARED but UNWRITABLE`. It uses "declared" of a
  `never` key, but it states no count and adjudicates no "declares exactly" sentence, and
  its second word is exactly the axis this counting rule excludes on. So the sentences as
  written here — "not counted", never "not declared" — are consistent with it rather than
  in conflict, which is why I did not stop. If the seat reads that line as the counting
  rule, the exit channel applies and this PR is the wrong repair.

Also noted, not filed and not touched: `packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/widget-dom-leak-sweep.test.tsx`
carries a THIRD copy of the same member-list sentence
("`IconSchema` and `SpinnerSchema` declare only `icon` / `size` / `color`"), with an extra
attribution imprecision of the objectui#9753 kind — `SpinnerSchema` declares neither
`icon` nor `color`. Out of this card's file surface.

## Evidence

- **Before/after probe**, whitespace-tolerant (strips comment markers, collapses all
  whitespace), same instrument and same corpus for every needle. Target went `0 → 1` in
  each of the two files; the **lit control** in each file (`MEASURED, not assumed` for
  `icon`, `declares exactly one key beyond the SDUI base` for `spinner`) stayed `1`; the
  **absent controls** (`DATED READING`, `true when written` — the repair this card is NOT)
  stayed `0` everywhere, before and after.
- **Changeset grade, MEASURED from a build**, never asserted by analogy.
  `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components build` green after building the dependency closure
  (`--filter '@object-ui/components^...'`), then a grep over the whole published surface
  (`files: dist, README.md, CHANGELOG.md, LICENSE` — 212 files): added prose `0` files,
  and pre-existing docblock prose from the same two files also `0`
  (`MEASURED, not assumed` `0`, `BARE_SPREAD_ON_SVG` `0`) — the comment channel reaches no
  published byte — while the live controls on that same corpus read `animate-spin` `3`
  files and `lucide-react` `5`. Hence the empty-frontmatter changeset;
  `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` exits `0` and prints that the declaration is
  a complete answer.
- **Serial constraint** re-taken over the open-PR 全集 immediately before the first write,
  not over this round's branches: all 10 open PRs, file lists read through the API
  (the release PR paged through), **zero** touch either target file.
- Exit codes captured to disk before any pipe; heavy work through
  `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` (both builds printed `VERDICT command-exit 0`).

Gate and test results are in the card report comment (`os-dev-report`).
